_comment: Calibrated 2-visit/3-visit linking operating point for the same-night NEO discovery pipeline. Read by trail_state_link.py via --op-point (CLI flags override individual values). sn_run.slurm passes this file so the op-point is versioned config, not magic numbers in the launcher.
model_version: seg_v2 depth-4 (iter08) segmentation + focal-cutout CNN postproc
calibrated_on: 80 off-ecliptic injection fields, 2026-06, realistic ~34-min WFD same-night cadence
score_min_rationale: Evidence-backed (THRESHOLD_DECISION.md): 0.80 is the LOWEST VALIDATED score in the lambda(S) sweep, giving the highest validated SNR-resolved faint-fast completeness (1.7% SNR 2-10 under the SHIPPED 2v op mfsnr10+chi5+rate[1,8], verified vs the sweep cache; monotone-DECREASING in S: 1.6% at 0.85, 1.3% at 0.90 -- the 10.4% blended figure is bright-SNR>10 dominated, NOT the faint-fast bin). Monotone-in-S is mechanism-level (higher S -> fewer dets -> fewer pairs), op-independent. The 3+visit discovery tier is FAR-pure here (lambda_3v=0/night, recovers NY2), so raising S buys no 3v-purity gain while costing completeness; chi2-gated 2v false rate is manageable (0.12/field-night). Lowering S below 0.80 is unvalidated and floods the 2v alert stream. 0.80 = single-floor compromise pinned upward only by 2v-alert flooding, not by any 3v-purity constraint.
threshold_decision: THRESHOLD_DECISION.md (faint-fast bin SNR 2-10, rate>1 deg/day): 3+visit incl. 2v->3v promotions = DISCOVERY (purity ~100%, the (FP)^N collapse), but same-night faint-fast discovery completeness is CADENCE-LIMITED and small (WFD pairs-dominated, >=3 same-night rare; promotion lifts 33% of true 2v to pure 3v at 0 false) -- bulk of faint-fast discovery needs multi-night. 2-visit = ALERT/candidate stream (purity-floor rule: faint-fast 2v caps ~8% at any S, below any discovery floor, never claimed as discovery, emitted as chi2-ranked alerts.jsonl). Shipped 2v op = mfsnr10+chi5+rate[1,8]; mfsnr10 suppresses faint-fast completeness ~2.4x (open lever for the alert sub-stream, see notes). No single-night 2v threshold reaches discovery purity (proven exhaustively across parallax, orbit-prior, sky-region, partner-recovery, pixel forced-phot, CNN fine-tune).
notes: chi2_2v_max=5 is the PRIMARY geometric purity lever: tightening 10->5 gives +45% 3-sigma completeness (0.070->~0.10) at no purity cost (true-pair chi2 median ~4 vs false ~39). mfsnr_min_2v is a CADENCE DIAL: ~10 at the 34-min WFD gap; lower to ~5 at rapid cadence to recover fast FAINT movers (long trails have low matched-filter SNR). CAVEAT (measured, corrects an earlier overstatement): mfsnr>=10 does NOT delete the faint-fast bin -- 44 of the SNR5-10 movers survive it (mf_snr = matched-filter TRAIL SNR != detection SNR; a long-trail fast mover can have mf_snr>=10 at detection-SNR 5-10). It SUPPRESSES faint-fast 2v completeness ~2.4x (no-mfsnr ~4% -> 1.7% with mfsnr10+tighter chi2) for per-link purity. OPEN LEVER: an alert stream isn't purity-gated, so applying mfsnr10 to the faint-fast 2v ALERT sub-stream pays completeness for purity it doesn't use -- candidate to drop for faint-fast alerts (kept for now; correct for the general 2v op). promote_3v attaches a real 3rd same-night detection on the precise chord track -> pure 3+visit tier (validated: 33% of true 2v promoted, 0 false). 3+visit tier = 3-sigma discoveries; 2-visit = follow-up candidates (~8% faint-fast purity, base-rate limited).
